'''Missile Racks''' are unguided, dumbfire missile hardpoints. Unlike [[Seeker Missile Rack|Seeker Missile Racks]], their missiles travel in a straight line once fired and don't lock onto a target, trading tracking for reliability against a target's own countermeasures.

== Overview ==

Each Missile Rack carries a small, fixed number of missiles rather than drawing from the ship's weapon capacitor, so ammunition management matters more than heat management for this weapon. A single hit can do serious damage to shields or hull, making Missile Racks a common choice for burst-damage builds and for finishing off a target that has already been worn down by sustained weapons fire.

Because they don't track, Missile Racks reward a Commander who can line up a shot manually, and they are unaffected by an enemy [[Chaff Launcher]] (which only disrupts gimballed and turreted tracking).
